question: Which Union Territory of India lies in the Bay of Bengal?

options.text: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Andaman Nicobar Islands__

 
• Least densely populated Union Territory in India.
 
• Barren Island is the largest active volcano in Andaman.
 
• Saddle Peak is the largest peak in Andaman.
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands come under the jurisdiction of the Kolkata High Court.
